rv.q: Dating men who “want to keep it casual” proves awkward. Gradually, eventually, the woman begins to move on with the rest of her life. While there’s no happy ending, the conclusion offers a sense of hopefulness.

It would be unfair to say that 'Pre-Existing Condition' sometimes feels like one [a PSA]. But I would be lying to deny that much of the drama in watching this play comes from knowing something about it that's not in the script.
